# PT Pelican Mitra Sejati

> Batam-based marine, oil & gas, and industrial engineering solutions provider delivering trusted technical support, diesel engine overhauls, vessel automation, and power generation systems since 2014.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: PT Pelican Mitra Sejati (Pelican Marine & Industrial Engineering)
- **Established**: 2014
- **Headquarters**: Jl. Ahmad Yani, Komplek Taman Niaga Blok M Nomor 5, Sukajadi, Batam 29432, Kepulauan Riau, Indonesia
- **Coverage**: Batam shipyards, offshore platforms, Riau Islands, and national industrial zones
- **Contact Hotline**: +62 877 8780 6333
- **Official RFQ WhatsApp**: +62 877 8780 6333
- **Website**: https://pelican-ms.com

## Core Engineering Capabilities
- **Rental Armada Genset (25 kVA - 1250 kVA)**: Heavy-duty diesel generator fleet (silent type and containerized) with resistive load bank verification, distribution panels, and 24/7 certified mechanical operators. Same-day mobilization to Batam shipyards.
- **Otomasi Kapal & Elektrikal Maritim**: Troubleshooting, repair, and programming of vessel Alarm Monitoring Systems (AMS), steering gear controls, thruster pitch controls, and main switchboard synchronization.
- **Kalibrasi Tersertifikasi MARPOL**: Authorized inspection and calibration for Oil Discharge Monitoring Equipment (ODME) and 15 ppm Bilge Alarm (OWS) compliant with IMO MEPC resolutions.
- **Rekayasa Mekanik & Overhaul Mesin Diesel**: Periodic overhaul, crankshaft reconditioning, precision laser alignment, and in-situ repairs for marine diesel engines (Cummins, Caterpillar, Yanmar, Perkins, Daihatsu, Niigata).
- **Pengadaan Suku Cadang Resmi (Spare Parts)**: Genuine Cummins engine components, Technoton differential fuel flow meters, and fuel level sensors with manufacturer warranty.
